text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting approval to install all-way stop control at the intersection of Nashdene Road and Tiffield Road. Based on the assessment undertaken, the installation of all-way stop control is recommended and should enhance safety for all road users.
The Scarborough Community Council: 1. Authorized all-way compulsory stop control at the intersection of Nashdene Road and Tiffield Road.
